decisive_spans.text: Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma

response.rationale: The histopathology findings directly support Abdominal Endometriosis by describing endometrial glands and stroma, which is the definitive characteristic of endometriosis. While Endometrioma also mentions endometrial glands and stroma, the specific location and description of the mass in the vignette align more directly with Abdominal Endometriosis.
